newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan in talks to buy co - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan in talks to buy co - WSJ.

text.p: J.P. Morgan & Co Inc is involved in talks to acquire a 45 percent stake in American Century Cos, a mutual fund company, for about $900 million, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said that an agreement in principle could be signed in July.
Terms under discussion would give Morgan an option to increase its stake in American Century to 50 percent within the next three years, though it still would hold less than half the voting shares.

Unnamed sources familiar with the talks, which were reported over the weekend in Barron's magazine, said Morgan would like to immediately buy 100 percent of American Century. However, the Stowers family, which controls American Century, wants to hold onto a majority of the voting stock.
